context:
Goal: a push of every branch never asks you, and agent branches never reach GitHub (your 2026-11-02 ruling).
Problem (rule): as built, a push of every branch from a lane is allowed when main is up to date, but it also sends other agents' local branches, and you ruled at 16:08 CST that such a push is allowed whenever it would not update main, so a change needs your word.
Based on (ruling): your 16:08 CST answer: a push of every branch never asks; it is refused when it would update main, and allowed otherwise.
Based on (read): the reviewer's dry run: `git push --all` sends `refs/heads/worktree-agent-0123456789abcdef`.
Departs from: your 16:08 CST "allowed otherwise" — also refuses a push of every branch while a local agent-named branch exists.
Meanwhile: the lane fixes its other review findings; on a, it folds this change in before its last review.
home: decision plain-push-asks (the ruling on which plain pushes ask)

options.gain: No push can carry a stray agent branch to GitHub.
options.how: The lane adds the refusal before its last review round.
options.label: Refuse it while an agent branch exists (Recommended)
options.lose: A push of every branch is refused in a repo with live agent worktrees, so each branch is pushed by name.

options.label: Allow it as built
options.lose: Agent branches can land on GitHub when a lane pushes every branch.

reply: You answered in chat at 09:12 CST (relayed by the coordinator): "i just care about not being asked while also not causing conflicts or losing work -- with that sort of outcome what answer is best?" The coordinator answered A for that outcome: a push of all branches is refused while an agent's scratch branch exists, so scratch branches never reach GitHub and you are never asked. Lane 4VY5 builds it; it can still be undone before it merges.
short: Refuse push --all while agent branches exist?
title: Should a push of every branch be refused while a local agent branch exists, so agent branches never reach GitHub?
why: As built, such a push from a lane can carry other agents' branches to GitHub.
